metrics.label: Fixed Assets
metrics.definition: Net book value of property, plant and equipment held at the period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include tangible fixed assets net of accumulated depreciation; exclude intangible assets (captured separately) and current assets.

metrics.label: Intangibles
metrics.definition: Net book value of intangible assets such as goodwill, software and acquired intangibles at the period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include capitalised intangibles net of amortisation; exclude tangible fixed assets.

metrics.label: Trade Receivables
metrics.definition: Amounts owed by customers for goods/services delivered, net of provisions, at the period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include trade debtors net of bad-debt provision; exclude other receivables and prepayments (in Other Current Assets).

metrics.label: Inventory
metrics.definition: Value of stock/inventory held at the period end, net of provisions.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include raw materials, WIP and finished goods net of obsolescence provision.

metrics.label: Other Current Assets
metrics.definition: Other current assets not classified as receivables, inventory or cash (e.g. prepayments, other debtors).
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include prepayments and sundry current debtors; exclude trade receivables, inventory and cash.

metrics.label: Cash & Equivalents
metrics.definition: Cash on hand and short-term liquid deposits/equivalents at the period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include cash and near-cash instruments; exclude undrawn facilities and restricted cash unless treated as cash.

metrics.label: Trade Payables
metrics.definition: Amounts owed to suppliers for goods/services received at the period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include trade creditors; exclude accruals (captured separately) and debt. Enter as a negative figure.

metrics.label: Accruals
metrics.definition: Accrued expenses and other short-term liabilities not yet invoiced at the period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include accrued costs and deferred items; exclude trade payables and interest-bearing debt. Enter as a negative figure.

metrics.label: Senior Debt
metrics.definition: Outstanding senior term debt drawn at the period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include senior facility term loans; exclude RCF drawings (separate line) and shareholder loans. Enter as a negative figure.

metrics.label: RCF Drawn
metrics.definition: Amount drawn under the revolving credit facility at the period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include only drawn RCF balance; exclude undrawn availability and senior term debt. Enter as a negative figure.

metrics.label: Shareholder Loans
metrics.definition: Loans provided by shareholders/sponsor (often subordinated) outstanding at the period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include shareholder/PIK/subordinated sponsor loans; exclude third-party senior debt and RCF. Enter as a negative figure.

metrics.label: Change in Working Capital
metrics.sign_convention: cash inflow positive, outflow (working-capital absorption) negative
metrics.definition: Monthly cash impact of movements in operating working capital (receivables, payables, inventory).
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include only cash-affecting movements in trade working capital; a build-up of working capital is a cash outflow (negative), a release is an inflow (positive). Exclude non-cash accruals and financing items.

metrics.label: Capex
metrics.definition: Cash capital expenditure on property, plant, equipment and intangibles.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include cash paid for fixed and intangible asset additions in the month (entered negative). Exclude depreciation, non-cash additions and acquisition consideration.

metrics.label: Cash Taxes
metrics.definition: Corporate income taxes actually paid in cash during the month.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include tax cash payments (entered negative); the quarterly pattern of values suggests instalment payments. Exclude the P&L tax charge and deferred tax.

metrics.label: Cash Interest
metrics.definition: Interest and financing charges paid in cash during the month.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include cash interest and financing fees paid (entered negative). Exclude accrued/PIK interest not settled in cash and principal repayments.

metrics.label: Debt Repayments
metrics.definition: Scheduled or voluntary repayments of debt principal in the month.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include cash principal repayments/amortisation (entered negative); the quarterly €250k pattern implies scheduled amortisation. Exclude interest and new drawdowns.

metrics.label: Opening Cash
metrics.definition: Cash balance at the start of the month; the first month is entered and subsequent months carry forward the prior closing balance.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Only the opening balance for the first period (D17) is a manual input; later columns equal the prior month's Closing Cash.

metrics.label: Reporting entity:
metrics.definition: Name of the legal/reporting entity to which this reporting pack applies.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Should hold the specific portfolio-company entity or consolidation name being reported; not a period, currency, or numeric value.

metrics.label: As-of date:
metrics.definition: The reporting/as-of date governing the pack; drives the AsOfDate named range used by downstream sheets.
metrics.qualification_criteria: A single calendar date (period-end) for the report; not a range or text label.

metrics.label: Reporting FX (USD→EUR):
metrics.definition: The USD-to-EUR conversion rate applied when translating figures into the reporting currency; feeds the RptFX named range.
metrics.qualification_criteria: A positive FX rate expressing EUR per USD (or as labelled); not a currency amount.

metrics.label: Covenant Limit (x)
metrics.definition: The maximum permitted Net Leverage under the credit agreement for each test date.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Enter the leverage covenant threshold agreed in the facility documentation for each quarterly test date; do not enter the actual leverage or headroom here.

metrics.label: ARR (€m)
metrics.definition: Annual Recurring Revenue — annualised value of active recurring/subscription contracts at period end, in millions of euros.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include annualised recurring subscription/contract revenue only; exclude one-off, professional-services, or non-recurring revenue. State as €m as per the label.

metrics.label: Net Revenue Retention %
metrics.definition: Net Revenue Retention — recurring revenue from the existing customer base at period end versus one year prior, including expansion, contraction and churn, expressed as a percentage.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Measure the existing cohort only (expansions/upsells/downgrades/churn); exclude revenue from new customers acquired in the period.

metrics.label: Logo Churn %
metrics.definition: Logo Churn — proportion of customer accounts (logos) lost during the period relative to the opening customer count.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Count number of customers/logos lost, not revenue lost; base on opening logo count for the period.

metrics.label: CAC (€'000)
metrics.definition: Customer Acquisition Cost — sales & marketing cost to acquire a new customer, in thousands of euros.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include sales & marketing spend attributable to acquiring new customers divided by new customers won; exclude retention/account-management cost. State in €'000.

metrics.label: Headcount (FTE)
metrics.definition: Total headcount expressed in full-time-equivalents at period end.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Count full-time equivalents (part-timers pro-rated); basis should be consistent period to period (period-end vs average).

metrics.label: Recurring Revenue
metrics.definition: Predictable, repeatable revenue (e.g. subscription/contracted/maintenance income) recognised each month.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include contracted, subscription or otherwise repeating revenue streams; exclude one-off project, setup or transactional revenue (which belongs in Non-recurring Revenue).

metrics.label: Non-recurring Revenue
metrics.definition: One-off or non-repeating revenue such as project, implementation or transactional income.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include one-time project, setup and transactional revenue; exclude any recurring/contracted income (which belongs in Recurring Revenue).

metrics.label: Cost of Goods Sold
metrics.definition: Direct costs of delivering revenue (cost of sales).
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include direct/variable costs attributable to revenue delivery entered as a negative number; exclude staff overhead and general operating expenses captured in Staff Costs and Other Opex.

metrics.label: Staff Costs
metrics.definition: Employee-related operating costs (salaries, wages, benefits, employer taxes) below gross profit.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include payroll and employment-related costs entered as a negative number; exclude direct delivery labour if already captured within Cost of Goods Sold.

metrics.label: Other Opex
metrics.definition: Other operating expenses below gross profit not classified as staff costs.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include general overheads (premises, IT, marketing, professional fees, etc.) entered as a negative number; exclude staff costs, COGS, depreciation, amortisation and exceptional items captured elsewhere.

metrics.label: Exceptional Items
metrics.definition: One-off or non-recurring items below EBITDA (e.g. restructuring, transaction costs, impairments).
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include non-recurring, non-operating charges/credits management considers exceptional (entered negative if a cost); exclude ordinary operating costs captured in COGS, Staff Costs or Other Opex.

metrics.label: Depreciation
metrics.definition: Depreciation charge on tangible fixed assets.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include depreciation of property, plant and equipment entered as a negative number; exclude amortisation of intangibles (captured separately).

metrics.label: Amortisation
metrics.definition: Amortisation charge on intangible assets.
metrics.qualification_criteria: Include amortisation of intangibles/goodwill entered as a negative number; exclude depreciation of tangible assets (captured separately).

notes: 'Accounts receivable, trade' directly matches trade debtors net of provisions; qualifies as trade receivables.
'Stock / inventories' matches inventory definition including raw materials, WIP and finished goods.
'Cash at bank' matches cash and near-cash instruments; qualifies as cash and equivalents.
'Accounts payable' matches trade creditors; source samples appear positive but template requires negative, so sign_flip=true.
'Term loan A' matches senior facility term loan; source is positive, template requires negative, so sign_flip=true.
'Revolving credit facility drawn' is an exact conceptual match; source positive, template requires negative, sign_flip=true.
'Annualised recurring revenue' matches ARR definition of annualised active recurring/subscription contracts.
'Logo churn (monthly)' directly matches logo churn % definition — proportion of customer accounts lost.
'Total employees (FTE)' directly matches headcount in full-time equivalents at period end.
'Cost of sales' matches COGS definition; source samples appear positive, template expects negative, so sign_flip=true.

'One-off items addback' is the closest match to exceptional/non-recurring items; source is presented as an addback (positive), template expects negative cost entry, so sign_flip=true. Moderate confidence as 'addback' framing may differ.
